body.x: iCubis( www.icubis.com) introduced 'Easy & Elly' 3D Animal Character Kids' App for English Education at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

'Easy & Elly' is an English education content for children, featuring pedagogics based on 'Phonics' which enables children to get reading and writing skills easily. It entertains the children with 3D animal characters( the fox 'Easy' and the elephant 'Elly') and animation game.
In the show, iCubis brought more completed product than last year and attempted to expand the business displaying Easy & Elly character cases for Galaxy S4.

CEO Wook-Gi Jang said "Along with launching character messenger themes, we are just before to release updated Android version and second version of the earlier one which has done with user test. We will have meeting with device companies in recognition tech industry who need content."

iCubis participated in the show as it had been selected for excellent startups by SmartContentCenter. iCubis equally placed its service to let foreign reporters learn the service at Showstoppers which was important media press event. Furthermore, iCubis had chance to get advice on global marketing from Strong Ventures CEO John Nam, Tapas media CEO Chang-Won Kim, KOTRA SV Sung-Kyu Lee at 3:1 'CES Global Consulting Program'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
